title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary on the Epistles to the Corinthians, translated by John Pringle, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Second Corinthians, chapter 9. In his Commentary on the Epistles to the Corinthians, in the John Pringle translation, Calvin writes at Second Corinthians 9, verse 1: This statement may seem at first view to suit ill, or not sufficiently well, with what goes before; for he seems to speak of a new matter, that he had not previously touched upon, while in reality he is following out the same subject. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 3, chapter 16.
